en-US.title: Oczko: Row Counter
en-US.subtitle: Knit & crochet, no account
en-US.description:
Oczko is a row counter for knitting and crochet that keeps your place: free for 5 crafting days a month, with your projects and export always yours; Pro is a subscription or a one-time purchase. With no account, your data stays on your device, you can export it any time, and deleted projects wait 30 days in Recently deleted. If taps pile up by mistake, Oczko offers to undo them.

COUNT WITHOUT LOSING YOUR PLACE
• One tap adds a row, with a vibration you can feel. Tap −1 to take one back.
• The screen stays awake while you count.
• A history shows every change with its time, and undo is one tap away.
• If taps pile up too fast, Oczko offers to undo them. An optional lock ignores stray taps.
• Oczko opens where you stopped, with your note next to the counter.

KEEP YOUR PATTERN NEXT TO THE COUNTER
• Add a pattern from a PDF, a Word file, a photo or scan of a page, or a web page. Save a link to a video too.
• Send patterns to Oczko from other apps with Share.
• Mark your current row on the pattern, highlight it and write notes with your finger. On iPad, write with Apple Pencil.
• Pattern and counter share one screen.

PROJECTS AND TOOLS
• Projects with parts, several counters, repeats and goals.
• Reminders such as "decrease every 6th row, 8 times".
• Needle or hook size, swatch, photos and notes for each project.
• A stopwatch for each session and a calendar of your crafting days.
• Yarn and tools stock, and a swatch calculator.
• Deleted projects stay in Recently deleted for 30 days.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Oczko works offline.
• Export everything at any time and import a backup on a new phone.

FREE AND OCZKO PRO
Oczko is free for 5 crafting days every month. A crafting day starts with your first row that day. Work in progress is never interrupted, and your projects and export always stay yours.
Oczko Pro removes the monthly limit. It is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew until you cancel in your Apple ID settings.
en-US.promoText: Count rows with one tap, keep your own pattern next to the counter and pick up where you stopped. Free for 5 crafting days a month; Oczko Pro removes the limit.
